reason: I might run the free audit out of curiosity, but I do month-end billing myself so I'd fix whatever it finds once and then I'm paying £99 a month for a tool that keeps telling me what I already know. Exporting CSVs and contract PDFs every month is more admin I don't have time for.
objection: It finds money once, then what am I paying for every month? And £4,281 over six months on a made-up 15-client MSP doesn't tell me anything about my book.
would_change_my_mind: If the free audit found a real, recurring leak in my own data that I'd genuinely missed, or if it was a one-off fee per audit instead of a monthly subscription.
